security_spec.violation_condition: QEMU executes vdot4a/vdot4au/vdot4asu/vdot4aus with vsew != 32 (e.g. SEW=8, 16, or 64) without raising an illegal instruction exception, because the TCG translator or decoder does not validate that SEW is exactly 32 before generating the dot-product micro-ops
security_spec.summary: Spec mandates SEW=32 only for Zvdot4a8i instructions; QEMU must trap reserved SEW values or risk computing dot products with mis-split sub-element boundaries causing silent data corruption in guest AI/ML workloads
